$comment: Machine-readable capability status. Every level below was established by running the referenced command in this repository. Entries not personally re-verified in a session carry verificationLevel 'unaudited' rather than an optimistic guess. Markdown must not contradict this file.

levelDefinitions.not_implemented: No working code path. Entry points must return blocked/not_implemented.
levelDefinitions.unaudited: Code exists but was not verified in this session. Do not cite as evidence.
levelDefinitions.offline_verified: Deterministic behaviour proven by the test suite; no model or Harmony.
levelDefinitions.simulator_verified: Proven end-to-end against a simulated host (e.g. a fake IPC daemon answering like the real plugin), but never against the real application.
levelDefinitions.real_model_verified: Executed against real model weights producing real artifacts.
levelDefinitions.real_harmony_smoke_verified: One successful operation against a licensed Harmony with evidence.
levelDefinitions.shot_verified: A complete shot was produced, rendered, reviewed and approved.

knownFailures: DWPose is evaluation-only: COCO-WholeBody training-data terms have not been approved for commercial production. RTMPose remains the required production default.

On the cartoon clip, median per-keypoint movement increased after smoothing from 0.0485 to 3.6150 px/frame because many raw points were nearly static; p95 improved from 35.3132 to 17.8263 px/frame. The current aggregate jitter objective is not a reliable production-quality metric for stylised animation.
Single person only. Identity is IoU + pose similarity, not tracking.
Validated on one five-second published 2D cartoon clip with a plain background; no varied-style, occlusion or multi-character robustness data.
capabilities.blockingReason: Production use remains blocked until a commercially approved pose provider replaces the DWPose evaluation provider and the temporal-quality metric is validated across several 2D animation styles. Real evaluation inference is verified.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Implement RTMPose with verified official weights, define a motion-aware temporal metric that separates static points from true articulation, and repeat acceptance on several published 2D cartoon styles.

knownFailures: DISABLED BY DEFAULT — these tools do not work unless the operator opts in. moho.input.* is gated on MOHO_MCP_ENABLE_UI_AUTOMATION, which defaults to false in src/moho/config.ts; platform-input.ts refuses at config.moho.enableUiAutomation and tools.ts additionally checks config.uiAutomation.enabled. moho.document.screenshot, screenshot_window and render are gated on MOHO_MCP_ENABLE_SCREENSHOTS, also default false, via checkScreenshotPermission(). Only the refusal side is verified. tests/moho/config.test.ts ('uiAutomation section > exists with conservative defaults') passes and confirms the flags default off; nothing exercises the enabled path.
No OS-level input event or screen capture has ever been executed and verified, on either platform. Upstream marks all of these 'simulated' with 'Real Moho Test: Not Executed'.
Windows is entirely unverified: src/moho/win32-input.ts has never been run: this integration was only ever exercised on macOS Apple Silicon.

Blind input automation is the most dangerous surface in the bridge. Clicks and keystrokes carry no native undo (upstream 'Native Undo: No') and land wherever the pointer resolves, so a stale coordinate can mutate an unrelated document. The declared mitigations (foreground enforcement, Moho-window bounding, 10/s rate limit, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X emergency stop) are configuration values in config.ts with no test proving any of them is enforced.

Screenshot output is unvalidated: nothing asserts a produced PNG decodes. This repository already contains 71 fabricated placeholder MP4s, so an untested capture path must not be assumed to yield real media.
capabilities.blockingReason: Off by default (MOHO_MCP_ENABLE_UI_AUTOMATION and MOHO_MCP_ENABLE_SCREENSHOTS both false), and the enabled path has never been executed or tested on either macOS or Windows. Only the refusal behaviour is verified. The safety rails are unenforced configuration.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: With MOHO_MCP_ENABLE_SCREENSHOTS=true, capture the Moho window and assert the PNG decodes to expected dimensions. Separately, with MOHO_MCP_ENABLE_UI_AUTOMATION=true, prove each declared rail actually holds: a click outside the Moho window is refused, the rate limit throttles, and the emergency stop halts a drag; commit as docs/evidence/moho-ui-automation/.
